title: FeedRevision - Data API
description: Holds the revision history of a specific feed item or comment, including a list of attributes that changed for each revision. This object is available in API version 34.0 and later.

Action.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Action.description: Holds the type of modification to the underlying feed item or comment attribute. Action can have the value Changed.

EditedAttribute.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
EditedAttribute.description: Identifies the part of the feed item or comment which was modified. A single revision can have many edited attributes.

FeedEntityId.description: Identifies the modified feed item or comment.

IsDeleted.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the record has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). This field is a standard system field.

IsValueRichText.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsValueRichText.description:

OriginNetworkId.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site in which a user modified the feed item or comment. This field is only available, if digital experiences is enabled for your org.

Revision.description: The revision number of the feed item or comment.

Value.description: Identifies the value of the EditedAttribute field before the update.

usage:
This object tracks the changes made to a feed item or feed comment and stores a list of attributes that changed for each revision.
